title: The invitation is also a trademark
governingQuestion: Who may enter Milano Fashion Week—and who may claim its name?
status: evidence-backed draft; recording, named interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The invitation is also a trademark
longform.opening: Before the first look, Milan controls a name and an invitation.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: CNMI describes itself as coordinating Italian fashion and publishes the official calendar; its live notice states events are invitation-only and that CNMI owns the Milano Fashion Week trademark.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Accreditation, calendar, app and organizer brand control form one public access layer, but invitations remain issued by individual event hosts.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No public organizer record reviewed establishes the guest-list software, identity checks or security stack for the next edition.

longform.closing: Milan’s technology is not futurist decoration. It is the system that moves authority from name to room to object to record.
